chunks: Only they attain it who forbear, and only a man of great good fortune can achieve it.

key_terms.ذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍ: A man of great good fortune/portion

ai.seo_question: What are the two conditions required to attain divine blessings according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (41:35) is often interpreted as referring specifically to the Ahl al-Bayt, whose patience during trials was exceptional, thereby linking 'great portion' to their unique spiritual status and authority. It underscores that enduring hardship with steadfastness is not merely a virtue but a necessary condition for attaining high ranks of divine proximity and leadership.
